description: Principal identity record. Carries the DID, display + full name, key metadata, rotation history, and authorized agents (scribes + future roles) for the principal who owns this vault. Lives on disk as `<self_root>/identity.md` — YAML frontmatter (machine-enforced fields) + markdown body (principal-editable prose). Same on-disk pattern as `tech.equanimi.secretariat.channelDef` and `tech.equanimi.secretariat.contract`. The active signing key referenced by `key_path` lives as raw PKCS#8 bytes at the relative path the field names (conventionally `identity/key`); rotated keys archive to `identity/key.<rotation-ts>` and append an entry to `key_rotations`. Agents the principal has delegated signing authority to are listed in `authorized_agents`; each agent has its own keypair stored separately in the platform keychain (`secretariat.agent.<name>`). This record is private to the principal's device — never sent on wire.

did.description: The principal's canonical decentralized identifier — `did:web:<host>` for domain-anchored principals, `did:key:z<multibase>` for self-contained identities.

did_method.description: DID method, redundant with the DID itself but useful for tooling that wants to branch without reparsing. MUST match the actual method of `did`.

display_name.description: Informal name for UI surfaces — `Rafa`, `Marcelo`. Validates against the `DisplayName` value object (non-empty, length-bounded, no control characters).

full_name.description: Optional formal name for envelope signatures and legal artifacts — `Rafael T. Ballestiero`. Defaults to `display_name` when absent.

key_path.description: Path to the active signing key, relative to `identity.md`. Conventionally `identity/key`. The file is raw PKCS#8 bytes (mode `0600`); never base64-encoded or wrapped here.

key_type.description: Cryptographic algorithm of the key referenced by `key_path`. Only `ed25519` today; expanded when key-type negotiation lands.

key_created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the active key was generated.

key_rotations.description: Append-only log of past key rotations. Each entry: `{archived_path, rotated_at, reason?}`. Active key always lives at `key_path`; rotated keys move to `identity/key.<ts>` and gain an entry here. Empty array for fresh installs; never deleted entries (auditability).

archived_path.description: Relative path to the archived key file (e.g. `identity/key.2026-09-12T14-30-00Z`).

authorized_agents.description: Agents the principal has explicitly delegated signing authority to. Each entry binds a non-principal DID + role + cognition substrate, recorded inside the principal's identity record (which is itself signed by the principal's key, transitively vouching for the agent). Granting an agent is an explicit principal act per `sec agent add <name> --role <role> --substrate <substrate>` (or the Tauri cognition-provider selection screen). `sec init` writes an empty array; agents are added on demand. Empty array for fresh installs; entries should not be deleted in production for auditability (use `sec agent remove` which marks revoked; reserved future field). Entry shape: `{did, role, name, substrate, added_at}`. See `docs/pitches/2026-05-21-substrate-for-themia.md` for the full design.

did.description: The agent's DID, distinct from the principal's. Typically `did:key:z<multibase>` — the agent has its own keypair stored in the platform keychain under `secretariat.agent.<name>`. Receivers resolve an envelope's author DID against this list to verify the agent is authorized by the claimed principal.

role.description: Agent role. Today only `scribe` (composes + signs envelopes on the principal's behalf). Future roles reuse this same field shape with new values: `auditor` (read-only review agent), `scheduler` (recurring envelope poster), `reader` (pure read access for dashboards/analytics).

name.description: Principal-chosen nickname for this agent. Free-form, used in CLI references (`sec agent rotate <name>`, `sec agent remove <name>`) and UI surfaces. Conventionally matches the cognition substrate identifier when not customized — e.g. `claude` for the `claude-code` substrate. Multiple agents can share a role but must have distinct names per principal.

substrate.description: Cognition provider this agent runs under. Per architectural invariant #5 (cognition is pluggable) the substrate is the principal's deliberate choice from the supported list. Today only `claude-code`. Future values as adapters land: `opencode`, `anthropic-api`, `ollama-<model>`, `bedrock`, etc. The substrate identifier maps to a Tauri / daemon adapter that wires the cognition channel (e.g. `claude-code` triggers `sec mcp install`).

added_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this agent was granted authority. Auditability — paired with the principal-record signature on the containing `identity.md`, gives a verifiable provenance trail for the delegation.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this identity record was first written. May predate the active `key_created_at` if a rotation has occurred.

$signature.description: Detached ed25519 signature over the record's canonical preimage, signed by the principal's active key. Format: `ed25519:<base64>` (64 raw bytes). Canonical preimage = `identity:v0:` byte prefix + UTF-8 serialization of a sorted-key JSON object containing every other field listed in this lexicon + U+001F + body bytes. Optional: legacy records written before signing landed have no `$signature` field; on first daemon tick post-upgrade, the record is re-signed with the active key. Verifiers MUST treat a missing `$signature` as 'legacy — trust the filesystem invariant'; verifiers MUST reject a present-but-invalid `$signature` (tampered record).
